apis.GET /torrents/{id_or_infohash}/peer_stat: Per peer stats in prometheus format
apis.GET /torrents/{id_or_infohash}/stream/{f: Stream a file. Accepts Range header to seek.
apis.POST /rust_log: Set RUST_LOG to this post launch (for debugging)
apis.POST /torrents: Add a torrent here. magnet: or http:// or a local file.
apis.POST /torrents/create: Create a torrent and start seeding. Body should be a local folder
apis.POST /torrents/resolve_magnet: Resolve a magnet to torrent file bytes
apis.POST /torrents/{id_or_infohash}/delete: Forget about the torrent, remove the files
apis.POST /torrents/{id_or_infohash}/forget: Forget about the torrent, keep the files
apis.POST /torrents/{id_or_infohash}/update_o: Change the selection of files to download. You need to POST json of the following form {"only_files": [0, 1, 2]}
